label: Local built working-tree asset snapshot — authoring candidate (34 routes: baseline16 + additions18)
method: Offline reads of a frozen built dist. Declared local asset bytes and static JS imports; no HTTP requests, browser timings, cache behaviour, Web Vitals or real-user measurements. gzip/Brotli values are estimates. Lazy images are declared bytes, not necessarily initial downloads. CSS fonts, responsive candidates and dynamic imports are separate potential dependencies.
